newsFlag.summary: Keenan Allen is expected to play in Week 1 despite an arrest on Sunday morning for drunken driving, though this off-field incident presents some risk to his availability.
Coach Zac Taylor expects Tee Higgins to be ready for Week 1 despite nursing an injury in the days before the season opener.
Coach Zac Taylor expects Ja'Marr Chase to be ready for Week 1 despite nursing an injury in the days leading up to the season opener.
Isiah Pacheco has been placed on injured reserve due to a MCL sprain and back injury suffered during training camp.
Malik Nabers is feeling good but has not committed to playing in Week 1 against the Cowboys, indicating uncertainty about his availability for the season opener.
Joe Milton III was waived by the Cowboys and is no longer on the roster.
Tyler Loop missed two kicks in the preseason finale, prompting the Ravens to add kicker competition by signing Jake Moody to the practice squad.
